name: Nashi pear
description: Round crisp pear with the texture of an apple and far more juice.

tcm.note: Li is cool, moistens the lung and stops dry cough — a standard autumn fruit.

nutrition.highlight: an apple's crunch, a pear's juice

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.

effects.note: A randomised crossover trial found juice from Korean pear — Pyrus pyrifolia cv. Shingo, the same species as nashi/Asian pear under a different cultivar name — measurably lowered blood acetaldehyde and cut hangover severity by roughly a fifth in the hours after drinking, alongside faster blood alcohol clearance; supporting lab work found the pear boosts the very enzymes (alcohol and aldehyde dehydrogenase) that break both compounds down. The trial was small (14 men) and single-blind rather than double-blind, so this is promising rather than settled. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
